answer_checks.gt_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT json_extract(cells,'$[0]') AS cid, CAST(json_extract(cells,'$[2]') AS REAL) AS val FROM sheet_rows WHERE file='contract-register-fy26.xlsx' AND row_no>1), s AS (SELECT json_extract(cells,'$[0]') AS cid, CAST(json_extract(cells,'$[2]') AS REAL) AS amt FROM sheet_rows WHERE file='revenue-schedule-fy26.xlsx' AND row_no>1), v AS (SELECT c.cid AS cid, c.val AS val, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amt) FROM s WHERE s.cid=c.cid),0) AS rec FROM c) SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(rec-val),0),2) FROM v WHERE rec-val > (CASE WHEN val*0.001>100 THEN val*0.001 ELSE 100 END)
